job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
关于团队与岗位

我们正在打造 AI Native My Notes，围绕会议、个人记录和知识工作，探索下一代 AI Native productivity experience。
我们关注的重点不是构建通用 AI Infrastructure，而是将大模型、Agent、Retrieval、Memory 和 Semantic Layer 等能力真正融入产品，解决真实用户问题。
在这个岗位中，你会工作在 Software Engineering 与 AI Native Application Engineering 的交叉地带：根据 My Notes 的产品场景设计和实现 Agent Harness、Semantic Layer、Context / Memory、Retrieval、Evaluation 等 application-layer capabilities，并将其持续演进为可靠、高质量的产品体验。

岗位职责

  • 参与 AI Native My Notes 核心研发，围绕会议助手、实时记录、AI 总结、内容理解、知识沉淀与个人知识管理等场景，打造世界一流的 AI Native 产品体验
  • 设计和实现面向 My Notes 产品场景的核心 AI 能力，包括 AI Agent、Agent Harness、任务规划、Tool Calling、Context / Memory、RAG、智能工作流和 AI Chat
  • 设计和建设 My Notes 的 Semantic / Knowledge Layer，对 Meeting、People、Topic、Project、Decision、Action Item 等用户知识进行建模、关联和检索，为 Agent 提供高质量 Context 和长期 Memory
  • 围绕具体产品体验设计 Agent 的 Execution Loop、Tool System、State / Context Management、Error Recovery 和 Human-in-the-loop 机制，使 Agent 能够可靠地完成复杂用户任务
  • 负责核心功能的端到端设计与实现，覆盖前端 / 客户端、服务端、数据以及 AI 能力集成，推动 AI 能力从 Prototype 快速走向生产级产品
  • 持续优化 Prompt、Context、Retrieval、Agent Workflow 和模型使用策略，通过数据、评测和用户反馈提升 AI 效果、稳定性、延迟和成本效率
  • 建设 AI Application 的 Evaluation、Tracing、Observability 和质量体系，系统性分析线上 Bad Case，并推动 Agent 和模型效果持续迭代
  • 负责关键系统的性能、稳定性、可靠性和可扩展性，解决 AI 应用在实时性、大规模用户、长上下文和复杂任务执行场景下的工程问题
  • 与 AI Platform / Infra 团队协作，充分复用公司已有的模型、Runtime 和基础设施能力；同时根据 My Notes 产品需要建设 application-specific capabilities
  • 深度参与产品讨论，从用户真实问题和 AI 能力边界出发探索新的产品形态，而不仅仅是完成已有需求
  • 探索和实践 AI Native Engineering，将 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Agent 等能力深度融入需求分析、技术设计、编码、测试、Code Review 和研发流程

任职要求

  • 扎实的计算机基础和软件工程能力，能够编写高质量、可维护、可测试、可演进的生产级代码
  • 有较强的软件工程背景，在前端 / 客户端 / 服务端至少一个方向具备较深积累，并具备端到端解决复杂问题的能力
  • 有 AI Agent / Agent Harness 的实际项目经验，理解 Agent Execution Loop、Tool Calling、State Management、Context Management、Error Recovery 等核心机制
  • 不局限于调用模型 API 或使用现成 Agent Framework，能够理解 Agent Framework 背后的设计，并针对具体产品场景设计和实现定制化 Agent 能力
  • 对 LLM / AI Application Engineering 有深入理解和实践经验，熟悉 Prompt Engineering、RAG、Tool Calling、Agent、Context / Memory Management 等常见模式
  • 对 Semantic Layer、Knowledge Modeling、Entity / Relationship Modeling 有较好的理解，能够设计面向 Agent 的知识组织、Context 构建和 Retrieval 方案
  • 能够理解不同模型的能力边界，并围绕 质量、延迟、成本和稳定性 做合理的模型与系统设计
  • 有复杂系统设计和工程实践经验，能够快速理解大型代码库和系统架构，定位关键瓶颈并提出系统性方案
  • 产品思维强，能够从用户真实问题出发判断 AI 应该解决什么问题，以及什么样的 AI 体验才真正有价值
  • 熟练使用 AI Coding 工具，能够将 AI 深度融入日常研发流程，并对 AI 如何改变软件研发模式有自己的理解
  • 学习能力和技术判断力强，能够快速跟进模型、Agent Framework、AI Infra 等新技术，并判断哪些能力应该直接复用、哪些需要根据产品场景进行定制
  • 主动性和 Ownership 强，能够在需求和技术路径并不清晰的情况下主动定义问题、探索方案并推动落地
  • 具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能够清晰阐述技术方案、AI 系统设计和工程取舍

加分项

  • 有复杂 Agent Runtime / Multi-Agent / Long-running Agent 系统的生产环境研发经验
  • 有 LLM Evaluation、Tracing、Observability、Bad Case 分析、Prompt / Workflow 优化相关经验
  • 熟悉 LangGraph、Claude Agent SDK、OpenAI Agents SDK、LlamaIndex 等一种或多种 Agent / AI Application Framework，有阅读、扩展或自行实现类似框架核心机制的经验
  • 有 Knowledge Graph、Semantic Search、Entity Resolution、向量检索、Hybrid Search、Embedding、Knowledge Base、Long Context 等相关实践经验
  • 有复杂权限模型下的 Permission-aware Retrieval / Context Building 实践经验
  • 有会议助手、AI 助手、个人知识管理、智能写作、协作文档等 AI Native 产品经验
  • 日常重度使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 工具，并形成成熟的 AI Native 开发工作流
  • 有性能优化、稳定性建设、可观测性、分布式系统或大型系统架构演进经验
  • 对最新大模型、Agent、AI Coding 和 AI Native 产品保持高度关注，并能够快速将新技术转化为实际产品能力

job.title: Senior Product Manager, CX Data and Events
job.description:
The CX Product team builds the core experiences and platforms that power customer engagement across Zoom’s Contact Center and broader Zoom CX suite. The team is responsible for how customer interactions across voice, messaging, email, and work item channels are orchestrated, measured, and continuously improved upon in order for customers to drive superior customer experiences and make key operational decisions for their business.

Within the CX Product team, the CX Analytics product focuses on how event data is used to provide customers with the operational insights they need to make critical business decisions. This includes dashboards, out of the box reporting, custom reporting and AI driven insights.

As a Senior Product Manager for CX Analytics, you will drive innovation in how CX data is surfaced and reporting on both in real-time and historical experiences using cross product integrations. Your work will enable product experiences such as dashboards and reporting to be utilized by contact center management, supervisors and agents. , conversational insights and proactive recommendations used daily by supervisors, operators, and executives. The team plays a critical role in turning complex CX interactions into trusted, enterprise-grade product capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Partner on the strategy and execution for delivering data-driven and actionable analytics and intelligence to our customers; develop and maintain a roadmap in your area of responsibility that aligns with product and company goals; manage internal and external stakeholder communications and expectations.
  • Lead end-to-end product development efforts, from product discovery to post launch; collaborate with engineering, design and product marketing to define requirements and product success metrics, deliver features, and increase customer adoption.
  • Perform relevant market research, product research, feature research, competitor research, and more.
  • Collaborate with feature teams to derive business intelligence from data captured in the contact center system from different product feature areas.
  • Conduct research to identify emerging trends and technologies in the contact center industry; lead user research, market analysis, and competitive analysis to guide product development.
  • Partner with engineering to drive the right technology to ensure performance and scalability of reporting services within the Contact Center product suit.
  • Develop and maintain the direction of the data model by providing guidance and product solutions.
  • Ability to create a vision across a large collection of enterprise applications to provide a cohesive analytics and reporting experience.

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with experience working in agile product environments
  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of data platforms, analytics products, or event-driven systems in B2B SaaS
  • Strong experience with real time and historical analytics and reporting
  • Solid understanding of Tele-communications or Contact center domains, including interaction lifecycles, performance metrics, and operational workflows
  • Ability to use data—both quantitative and qualitative—to drive product strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across engineering, data science, design, and executive leadership
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong relationships.
  • Seeking a candidate that is detail oriented but able to shift and refocus on tasks in a short amount of time.
  • Someone with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive features to completion on their own.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic knowledge of AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and methodologies
  • Familiarity with the use of Figma, Figma Make, Product Board and Jira

job.title: ASR Engineer
job.description:
岗位描述：

我们正在寻找一位经验丰富的 ASR 算法工程师，加入 Zoom 的语音识别团队。您将负责为 Meeting、My Notes、ZVA、ZRA、ZCC等核心产品提供多语言语音识别能力，支持 40+ 语种的 ASR 服务。您将独立承担新增语种的开发与交付，参与 Speech LLM 架构研究与技术迁移，推动 ASR 技术基础设施建设，并在长音频识别、专有名词提升、低资源语种等真实业务场景中形成可落地的技术方案。

岗位职责：

•新增语种独立开发： 独立负责新增语种的ASR 开发工作，包括问题分析、数据处理、模型训练、评估优化和交付，形成稳定可发布的结果，支持团队多语种扩展能力。

•ASR 技术基础设施建设： 参与构建可复用的工具、平台、模型、评测体系和开发流程，将单个项目中的能力沉淀为团队级技术资产，提升整体交付效率。

•Speech LLM 架构研究与迁移： 深入解剖 Speech LLM 关键架构（Speech Encoder、LLM、Projector、Tokenizer 等模块），探索其在长音频识别、专有名词提升、低资源语种迁移等 Zoom 业务问题中的应用路径，形成兼顾效果、效率、稳定性与成本的可验证技术方案。

•核心语种维护与优化： 支持当前 ASR 业务需求，持续优化核心语种的识别效果、可读性和用户体验，并快速响应客户反馈和临时需求。

•前沿技术判断与引领： 从大量论文、开源项目和行业信息中筛选对业务有价值的技术方向，提出判断依据、组织实验验证并推动技术结论落地到产品。

任职要求：

•硕士及以上学历优先，计算机科学、人工智能、语音识别或相关专业；

  • 深度理解 Transformer 架构原理及主流 LLM 技术栈（如 LangChain、AutoGen、LlamaIndex），具备 LLM 预训练、微调、推理优化及评估的完整实践经验

  • 具备优秀的系统设计能力，熟悉分布式系统、微服务架构，有高并发、低延迟系统优化经验
  • 具备出色的技术 Leadership，能够推动跨团队协作，制定技术方案并落地执行
  • 优秀的问题分析与解决能力，能够在复杂场景下快速定位问题并提出创新解决方案
  • 良好的英文读写能力，能够阅读前沿论文并与国际团队高效协作
